sources.scope: 2026–27 EER arts. 3.5b, 3.6, 4.2b, 4.4, 5.5–5.7 and Appendix 1b. Controls the September DNUA major, electives, progression, workplace assessment and 180 EC.

curriculum: The September 2026 Dutch full-time Medicine cohort starts DNUA. The EER Appendix 1b credits reconcile to 165 EC of compulsory major and 15 EC of Year 2 profiling. Year 1 is 38.5 EC in core blocks, 9 EC in carousel modules and 12.5 EC in longitudinal courses. Year 2 is 42 EC in core blocks and lines, 3 EC in the remaining carousel module and 15 EC of profiling. Year 3 is 60 EC including 1 EC for the cross-year progress test. Adopted values for Movement and Perception and Lifespan are 10 EC each. The profile courses require intermediate level or above and approval without overlap with compulsory courses.
progression: EER Art. 4.2b requires all Year 1 credits and at least 45 EC from Year 2 including Year 2 clinical reasoning and practical line education before the 2 EC preparation block. The 9 EC workplace course follows the preparation block and hospital induction, adult resuscitation certification and history-taking training. Workplace assessment uses evidence of competence, clinical performance and professional conduct in a portfolio. The 13 EC Science and Bachelor Final Project requires the Year 2 interdisciplinary line. The progress test runs four times per year with attainment requirements towards graduation and carries a single credit. The normal Year 1 study advice threshold is 45 EC and differs from the complete Year 1 requirement for the clinical preparation block.
